whenToUse: There are rules such as length, digits, or symbols.
People need a way to check for typos on a phone.
whenNotToUse: A rules list on the login screen (the password was already chosen, so no rules are needed).
You only take a few digits, like a PIN (use an OTP input).
Passkeys or email links can replace passwords.

alternatives.name: Text Field
alternatives.reason: Ordinary input that doesn't need hiding.

accessibility: The show button announces its state with aria-pressed and keeps its name ("Show password").
The rules list connects to the input with aria-describedby and says whether each rule is met in words, not color.
autocomplete="new-password" lets password managers suggest a new password.
